g.text: each LCD_BUF_voidUpdate (5 ms) finds the next differing cell (round robin) and sends ONE thing: a set-cursor command if the cursor

text.style: font-size: 6.8px; font-family: 'Inter'; fill: #1f2933

g.text: is elsewhere, else the character. Here: cursor→8, "3", cursor→20, "N", " " … 3 differing cells + 2 cursor moves = 5 calls = 25 ms.
